title: Input-position segment of the configuration word
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean tape symbols, let $x$ be a Boolean input word, let $C$ be a configuration of $N$ on input $x$, and let $s\in\mathbb{N}$. The segment of the encoded configuration word obtained by dropping its first $W(2s+1)$ bits and then taking the first $w_P(|x|)$ bits is exactly the padded bit representation of the input-head position of $C$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean tape symbols
